metadata.scenario: A tenant calls about an additional charge on their rent statement that they believe is incorrect. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Jennifer Taylor. I’m calling because I noticed an additional charge on my grandmother's account that I believe is incorrect. I’m sorry to hear that, Jennifer. Let me pull up your grandmother’s account. Could you please hold for a moment? Of course, take your time. Thank you for your patience. Okay, I have her account here. Can you tell me which charge you're referring to? Yes, it’s listed as “Companion Care Service,” but it seems higher than what I was expecting. I see. The charge for Companion Care typically ranges from $25 to $30 per hour. How many hours were you billed for? It shows four hours, but I thought we agreed on three hours for this week. That does seem inconsistent. Let me double-check the schedule and service records to clarify that for you. Thank you. I just want to make sure we're only paying for what we agreed upon. Absolutely, I understand your concern. Please hold on for a moment. Sure, no problem. Jennifer, I found the notes. It looks like there was a miscommunication about the hours scheduled this week. I will correct that for you. Oh, I’m relieved to hear that. Thank you for resolving it. No problem at all! I will adjust the billing, and you should see the corrected charge in your next statement. That’s great. Just to confirm, will I get a confirmation email? Yes, you will receive an email confirmation of the adjustment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Actually, yes. My grandmother could use more regular companionship, especially on weekends. We can definitely help with that. Would you like me to set up a care plan for additional Companion Care services? Yes, let’s discuss how that works and the pricing. Great! The pricing is still between $25 to $30 per hour, and we can customize the schedule to fit her needs. That sounds good. Can you send me options via email? Absolutely, I’ll send you some options right after our call. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today! You’re very welcome, Jennifer. Thank you for choosing CareFirst Home Health. Have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
